claims.text: Conditional on the accepted integral box/Schur/Pieri presentation, for \(c=r-j=1\), \(p=q-i\ge2\), and \(\min(i,j)=2\), with \(d=ij\), \[ Q_d\oplus Q_{d+1}\oplus Q_{d+2} \cong\mathbb Z\bar x_0\oplus\mathbb Z\bar x_1\oplus\mathbb Z\bar x_2, \] where \[ x_0=s_{i^j},\quad x_1=s_{(i+1,i^{j-1})},\quad x_2=s_{((i+1)^2,i^{j-2})}. \] Moreover \(\bar y_1=-\bar x_1\) and \(\bar y_2=\bar x_2\), for \[ y_1=s_{(i^j,1)},\qquad y_2=s_{(i^j,2)}. \]

The requested opposite-boundary truncated certificate is established: retaining \(x_2\), the complementary minor on columns \((u,z,y_2)\) has determinant \(1\), where \[ u=s_{(i+2,i^{j-1})},\qquad z=s_{(i+1,i^{j-1},1)}. \]
